I had been assisting the Three Mages

I thought you, Princess, could put a

Could you tell me more about this
dangerous research?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 王は <PART> ――

original_jp: 閉じた時間〓を作り 死の運命から逃れる事を望んでいます
original_en:
is seeking to transcend this mortal coil
by creating a closed timeline.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: ―― <PART> 〓ち 神々との決別

original_jp: 〓相転〓とも違う オーディンすら持たぬ術を得ようというのか…

That is beyond transcendence. What he seeks
is a power possessed by Odin alone.

original_jp: そのためにドラゴンオーブを？

original_jp: 不死者やエルフで実〓をくり返し失敗を重ね たどり着いた結論です
original_en:
That was their conclusion...following
countless failed experiments on elves and
the undead.

original_jp: クッ…
original_en: Damn...

original_jp: ディパンだけが自然の摂理から逃れ永遠の〓栄を〓受しようとは…
original_en:
So Dipan alone would break free from the laws
of nature and enjoy eternal prosperity...

original_jp: 私も〓〓不可能だと思いました

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: シルメリア・ヴァルキュリア殿 <PART> ――

original_jp: 私を知っているの？
original_en: So you know of me.

original_jp: ダレス様から 少々 <PART> ――

original_en:
It is said the Dragon Orb has enough
power to set the whole world aflame.

original_en:
Even gods are powerless before it.

Let us then depart the forest for

original_en:
I beg your pardon. I had no choice but
to resort to such crude methods.

original_en:
You're not thinking of finding the orb
for Dipan, are you!?

original_jp: 探すのはディパンのためではないミッドガルドのためよ
original_en: For Dipan? No. For all Midgard.

speaker: Silmeria

original_en:
I will find the orb, and Alicia shall be
the Guardian.

A new world tree stemming from neither
the heavens, the underworld, nor the
world of mortals.

original_en:
Well, if that's your theory, then come
along and keep it from happening.

original_en:
But if you aren't sincere about fighting
Odin, you won't stand a chance.

original_en: Lezard Valeth, at your service.

We'll need everyone's strength to get
